title: Design System: Андрій та Ельфіда — Wedding Invitation

display.purpose: The couple's names, stacked one per line. Appears once in the document.

headline.purpose: Section headings. The gallery variant is uppercase at 0.04em.

title.purpose: Venue names and schedule times — serif at weight 600.

quote.purpose: Scripture on the terracotta band; the model for long-form italic serif.

body.purpose: All prose, at weight 300 and 1.9 line-height, bounded by a 620px measure.

label.purpose: Tracked capitals. Spacing moves inversely with size, 0.34em down to 0.14em.

script.purpose: Used exactly twice: the connector between the names, and the footer tagline.

shadows.name: pin-drop
shadows.purpose: The map marker and its placeholder pin — the only literal elevation in the system. Olive-tinted at 53% alpha, never neutral black.

motion.name: dur-reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-reveal fade and 18px rise. Long and unhurried by intent.

motion.name: dur-ui
motion.purpose: Hover and focus colour transitions on controls. Colour only — nothing moves.

components.name: Solid Button
components.description: The primary action. Used once per view — the directions link in the location section.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 22px; font-family: var(--f-sans, Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.25s ease, color 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-solid { background: var(--c-olive-deep, #4e5539); color: var(--c-cream, #f7f3e9); } .ds-btn-solid:hover { background: var(--c-olive-mid, #636a4a); color: var(--c-cream, #f7f3e9); } .ds-btn-solid:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-olive-deep, #4e5539); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action, identical in footprint to the solid variant. Inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: var(--c-olive-deep, #4e5539); border-color: var(--c-olive-deep, #4e5539); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--c-olive-deep, #4e5539); color: var(--c-cream, #f7f3e9); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-olive-deep, #4e5539); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Language Switcher
components.description: The only persistent control. Current language is marked by colour and weight, never by dimming the others.
components.css: .ds-langbar { display: flex; justify-content: center; padding: 12px; background: rgba(247, 243, 233, 0.86); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-header-border, #e4dfcf); } .ds-langgroup { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; background: var(--c-cream, #f7f3e9); border: 1px solid var(--c-switch-border, #cfd0b6); border-radius: 999px; } .ds-langdiv { width: 1px; height: 14px; background: var(--c-switch-divider, #d7d8c1); } .ds-lang { border: 0; background: transparent; font-family: var(--f-sans, Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.18em; padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--c-olive-mid, #636a4a); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.25s ease; } .ds-lang[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--c-olive-deep, #4e5539); font-weight: 600; } .ds-lang:hover { color: var(--c-olive-deep, #4e5539); } .ds-lang:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-olive-deep, #4e5539); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Section Rule
components.description: The signature divider and the system's only ornament: a 60px hairline, a 6px diamond, a 60px hairline. Purely decorative, hidden from assistive technology.
components.css: .ds-rule { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-rule-line { width: 60px; height: 1px; background: var(--c-terracotta, #c07c5a); } .ds-diamond { display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; background: var(--c-terracotta, #c07c5a); transform: rotate(45deg); flex: none; }

components.name: Verse Band
components.description: The single saturated field in the document. A tracked-capital reference flanked by pale rules, then the scripture in italic serif.
components.html:
Екклезіяста 4:9
Двом краще, ніж одному, бо мають хорошу нагороду за свою працю.
components.css: .ds-verse { background: var(--c-verse-band, #ae603c); padding: clamp(80px, 14vw, 150px) clamp(22px, 6vw, 60px); text-align: center; } .ds-verse-ref-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; } .ds-verse-line { width: 44px; height: 1px; background: var(--c-verse-rule, #e9c4b0); flex: none; } .ds-verse-ref { font-family: var(--f-sans, Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ffffff; } .ds-verse-quote { max-width: 760px; margin: clamp(28px, 5vw, 46px) auto 0; font-family: var(--f-display, 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif); font-style: italic; font-weight: 400; font-size: clamp(22px, 3.6vw, 40px); line-height: 1.45; color: var(--c-cream, #f7f3e9); text-wrap: pretty; }

components.name: Arch Photo Slot (empty)
components.description: The hero portrait frame in its unfilled state. A designed empty state — it must read as a photograph not yet taken, never as one that failed to load.
components.css: .ds-photo-arch { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center; width: clamp(220px, 44vw, 360px); aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; padding-bottom: 22px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--c-slot-fill, #e7e9d7); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--c-slot-hatch, #dfe2cd) 0, var(--c-slot-hatch, #dfe2cd) 1px, transparent 1px, transparent 12px); border: 1px solid var(--c-terracotta, #c07c5a); border-radius: 999px 999px 14px 14px; } .ds-photo-label { font-family: var(--f-mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: var(--c-olive-mid, #636a4a); }

components.name: Timeline Entry
components.description: One stop in the schedule. The only left-aligned block in the system, because its content is genuinely sequential.
components.html:
1. 11:00
    Вінчання
    Церква „Харул"
    Просимо прибути за 15 хвилин.
components.css: .ds-timeline { position: relative; max-width: 520px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 0 0 clamp(30px, 7vw, 56px); list-style: none; } .ds-timeline::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: clamp(6px, 2vw, 14px); top: 8px; bottom: 8px; width: 1px; background: var(--c-terracotta, #c07c5a); } .ds-timeline-item { position: relative; } .ds-timeline-node { position: absolute; left: calc(-1 * clamp(30px, 7vw, 56px) + clamp(6px, 2vw, 14px) - 5px); top: 6px; width: 11px; height: 11px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--c-cream, #f7f3e9); border: 1.5px solid var(--c-olive-deep, #4e5539); } .ds-timeline-time { font-family: var(--f-display, 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: clamp(28px, 5vw, 40px); line-height: 1; color: var(--c-olive-deep, #4e5539); } .ds-timeline-title { margin-top: 10px; font-family: var(--f-sans, Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--c-olive-mid, #636a4a); } .ds-timeline-venue { margin-top: 6px; font-family: var(--f-display, 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: clamp(15px, 2vw, 18px); color: var(--c-olive-deep, #4e5539); } .ds-timeline-note { margin-top: 4px; font-family: var(--f-sans, Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--c-olive-body, #5f6450); }

components.name: Backdrop
components.description: The floral watermark behind the whole invitation. The ink is composited onto the cream in the asset itself, and the layer is masked to an ellipse so it has no visible edge.
components.html: Ne-am rugat, iar Dumnezeu ne-a încrucișat drumurile.
components.css: .ds-backdrop-demo { position: relative; min-height: 220px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--c-cream, #f7f3e9); overflow: hidden; } .ds-backdrop { position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image: url('/backdrop.avif'); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: center; background-size: 124% 93%; -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse closest-side at center, #000 55%, transparent 100%); mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse closest-side at center, #000 55%, transparent 100%); -webkit-mask-size: 124% 93%; mask-size: 124% 93%; -webkit-mask-position: center; mask-position: center; -webkit-mask-repeat: no-repeat; mask-repeat: no-repeat; } .ds-backdrop-text { position: relative; max-width: 26ch; text-align: center; font-family: var(--f-sans, Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 300; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.9; color: var(--c-olive-body, #5f6450); }

narrative.overview:
The page is the card. Everything on screen behaves as though it were struck onto cream stock in two passes of ink — olive for the text, Carpathian terracotta for the ornament — and nothing appears that a press could not have produced. There are no gradients standing in for light, no drop shadows standing in for paper, no rounded rectangles standing in for surfaces. Rules are hairlines. Ornaments are diamonds. The one moment of colour is a solid block, the way a second ink plate covers a panel.

The mood is warm and hand-made and reverent and unhurried. Body text runs at a 1.9 line-height and uppercase runs are tracked as wide as 0.34em, which makes the page physically slow to read — deliberately. A guest arrives here by pointing a phone at a printed invitation, and the screen's job is to feel like a continuation of the paper in their other hand, not a departure from it. Warmth comes from the pigments and from the script face used at exactly two moments; formality comes from the serif, the symmetry, and the space.

Composition works by interruption. Long stretches of centred cream are broken twice: once by an arched portrait, once by a solid terracotta band carrying the verse. Those two gestures carry the entire structure of the page. Everything else is typography and air.
keyCharacteristics: Cream ground, olive ink, a single terracotta interruption
A floral watermark behind the cream, at the strongest opacity that still clears AA
Serif display, sans body, script signature — three voices, never a fourth
Hairline borders only; no border is thicker than 1px anywhere in the system
Symmetrical and centred by default; asymmetry must be earned by function
Fluid throughout — the system has no width breakpoints at all
Ornament is limited to one shape: a 45°-rotated square

rules.name: The Single Interruption Rule
rules.body: Terracotta appears as a solid field exactly once in the document — the verse band. A second saturated block would turn an interruption into a pattern and the composition would lose its only structural accent.

rules.name: The Decorative-Only Rule
rules.body: #c07c5a never carries text. It is exempt from contrast requirements precisely because it is only ever a diamond, a rule, or a border. Terracotta that must be read is #9e5330.

rules.name: The Measured Deviation Rule
rules.body: A palette value may be darkened to reach contrast; it may never be lightened for taste. Every deviation records its original value and its measured ratio in a comment beside it, and `npm run check:contrast` re-verifies all 35 pairs.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Playfair speaks (names, headings, venue, verse), Montserrat labels (eyebrows, body, controls, notes), Marck Script signs — and it signs exactly twice. A fourth face is unavailable: the fonts ship as content-derived subsets, so a new face means a new download on a rural connection.

rules.name: The Spaced Capital Rule
rules.body: No uppercase run is set without tracking. The floor is 0.14em and the ceiling is 0.34em, and the two move inversely with size. Uppercase at normal tracking is not part of this system.

rules.name: The Comma-Below Rule
rules.body: ș and ț must render with a comma below, never a cedilla. A cedilla is a spelling error to a Romanian reader, not a stylistic variant. Any change to the type stack is verified by pixel comparison before it ships.

rules.name: The Full-Alphabet Rule
rules.body: Every shipped weight must render both full Ukrainian Cyrillic and Romanian diacritics. A weight that exists in only one script cannot be used, because the same component renders in all three languages.

rules.name: The No-Breakpoint Rule
rules.body: This system contains no width-based media queries whatsoever. Every size, gap and measure is a clamp() or a flex basis, so the layout is continuous rather than stepped. Adding a min-width block means the design has failed to express itself fluidly — fix the clamp instead.

rules.name: The Small-Viewport Rule
rules.body: The hero measures in svh, never vh and never dvh. vh overflows behind mobile browser chrome and hides the date; dvh resizes as the address bar collapses and makes the page jump mid-scroll.

rules.name: The Centre Line Rule
rules.body: Centred is the default. A section may break alignment only when its content is genuinely sequential (the timeline) or genuinely paired (the location), and never for visual variety alone.

rules.name: The Arch Rule
rules.body: 999px 999px 14px 14px belongs to the hero portrait alone. It is the page's one architectural gesture and it stops being architectural the moment a second element borrows it.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every border is 1px, in a tone selected for the surface it sits on rather than a single generic grey. A thicker border is a signal this system does not have.

rules.name: The One Ornament Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one decorative shape. New sections do not get new motifs; they get the diamond at whichever of the four sizes fits.

rules.name: The Watermark Ceiling Rule
rules.body: The backdrop ink sits at 7% and cannot go higher. Every stroke darkens the ground behind whatever text crosses it, and two pairs have almost no headroom left: at 9% the footer tagline falls to 4.46:1 and fails AA. 7% is the strongest the drawing can be while the page still passes. Below 5% it is invisible on a phone in daylight, so the usable range is one band wide.

rules.name: The 44px Rule
rules.body: Every interactive target clears 44px in its smallest dimension. Inline links that cannot take a min-height take 6px of vertical padding instead. The audience uses this one-handed, in portrait.

rules.name: The Never-Dim Rule
rules.body: State is never expressed as opacity on text. Dimming composites the foreground toward the background and silently destroys contrast — opacity: .5 on the language pills measured 2.28:1. Quiet-versus-current is expressed with colour and weight, both above 4.5:1.

rules.name: The Visible-Without-Script Rule
rules.body: Reveal-on-scroll hides content only after JavaScript has confirmed it can also un-hide it. Nothing is styled opacity: 0 or display: none at rest and revealed later by a script that might not run.

dos: Do put every new value in src/styles/tokens.css first. No component may hardcode a hex, a font stack, or a type size — if a value is worth using it is worth naming.
Do run `npm run check:contrast` after touching any colour. It checks 35 pairs including composited opacity, and it is the reason the palette can be trusted.
Do express a new size as a clamp() between a 360px phone and a 1440px desktop.
Do reach for the diamond, the hairline rule, or tonal ground when a new section needs separation.
Do darken a colour to meet AA and record the original value and the measured ratio in a comment beside it.
Do design the empty state and the loaded state as the same box, so replacing a portrait with a landscape reflows rather than breaks.
Do keep the third olive (#636a4a) as the floor of the text hierarchy. Anything quieter than that is not text, it is decoration.
donts: Don't add a width-based media query. Fix the clamp().
Don't introduce a second solid terracotta field. There is one, and it holds the verse.
Don't express state with opacity on anything containing text.
Don't add a fourth typeface, or a weight outside the shipped ranges — Playfair 400–600 normal and 400–500 italic, Montserrat 300–600, Marck Script 400. The subsets contain nothing else.
Don't use vh or dvh for full-height layout. svh, always.

Don't reach for a shadow as the default way to separate two surfaces — use tonal ground or a hairline. Elevation is not forbidden here, but it is currently unused outside the map pin, so introducing it is a system-level decision rather than a local one.

Don't raise the backdrop's ink opacity above 7%, or place body text on a section that shows the backdrop without re-running npm run check:contrast — the watermark is part of the background those pairs are measured against.
Don't set uppercase without letter-spacing, or below 0.14em.
Don't exceed a 1px border. The 1.5px timeline node ring is the system's only exception and it is not a precedent.
Don't let a new element be visible only after JavaScript runs.
